card.name: Paying bills and rent, missed payments
card.fires_on: Words about paying household bills, rent or dues (bill, bills, rent, paid, make a payment). Also "missed" in missed-dose instructions.

modes.label: Paying bills
modes.description: Bill, rent or payment words right after or around the verb pay in everyday money talk.
modes.example: “For example, you pay the electric<< bill>> two or three times.

modes.label: Missed dose
modes.description: The word missed when a scheduled dose is missed, in dosing instructions.
